segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including one who avoided facial oils since age 12 and another who calls her skin oily-yet-sensitive, report the product does not feel greasy and does not worsen oiliness, though one reviewer noted it makes her face oily enough to help wipe off makeup.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry to extremely dry skin, especially in winter, report the oil keeps skin from flaking, deeply moisturizes, and that a few drops mixed into their routine is enough to last through cold or windy weather.
segments.combination: One long-time user with combination skin (previously oily) reports continued satisfaction with the oil's hydrating effect after 30+ years of trying facial oils.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing sensitive skin report no irritation and relief from dryness around the nose and mouth, though one separate sensitive-skin reviewer experienced welts and eye swelling and identified an allergic reaction.
segments.mature: Reviewers aged 45 to 74 with mature skin report softer, more hydrated skin, a healthier glow, reduced dryness, and compliments on looking younger, with one noting sun damage and deep wrinkles improved somewhat but the price is prohibitive for frequent repurchase.
segments.normal: A few reviewers without stating a specific concern report the oil absorbs quickly and leaves skin soft without describing any particular skin type issue.

concerns.aging: Reviewers focused on aging skin report a healthier glow, softer texture, and being told they look younger or 'have had work done'; one mature reviewer states fine lines diminished, while another explicitly says she can't speak to wrinkle reduction and one notes the product is 'just eo mix, no anti aging or anything else'.
concerns.dehydration: The majority of reviewers citing dryness or dehydration, including several with dry or mature skin, report the oil keeps skin from flaking and maintains moisture overnight and through winter; one reviewer says she still needs a separate moisturizer for it to work and one felt it required more product than advertised.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with acne-prone skin reports the product calms redness; no other reviewer discusses redness specifically.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer describes using the product to restore skin after dryness, irritation, or breakouts, calling it gentle but effective for bouncing skin back; another separately reports an allergic reaction with welts and swelling, indicating the formula does not suit every skin barrier.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with dry patches and age spots reports brighter, smoother, more supple skin over time even in a hot, dry climate.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin report no new breakouts and even a reduction in breakouts; however, one reviewer reports breakouts when using the oil without a moisturizer underneath, and another warns that acne-prone users should not overuse it.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers concerned about oiliness report the product absorbs without a greasy feel or oily residue, though one reviewer explicitly worried it would make her skin too oily before finding it did not, and another said it left her face oily enough to remove makeup.

aspects.libelle: Strong or spoiled scent in some units
High price relative to bottle size
Pilling when layered with other products

extraits.texte: I bought this from a beauty store and was eager to try it. First off, it has the smell of raw chicken when you rub it on your face. I wish it smelled better. I wore it for three nights and noticed small welts on the left side of my face and all down my neck. I stopped using it immediately and gave my face about a two week break. Because I paid so much for it, I wanted to try it again, so I tried it a few weeks later for two nights. The second night I tried it, I woke up the next morning and my right eye was so swollen. Clearly, I have an allergic reaction to the serum. I wish I could return it because I cannot use it and the bottle is basically full. Sadly, my loss.

Excellent product. I have dry patches, age spots, and live in Arizona. It is hard to find products that don't melt off of your face in the heat and I was reluctant to put an oil on my face and neck in this heat but decided to give this product a try. My first use and results were amazing. Each morning my skin was so soft and getting noticeably more supple. Over time my complexion is looking brighter, and the texture of my skin is becoming very smooth. There is no oily feeling and a little goes a long way, you only need a few drops. This bottle should last me well over 9-12 months, so it is a value and worth every cent. I appreciate a product that actually delivers what it claims. Thank you Kiehl's, wish I had found you sooner.
Made a huge difference in my skin after only one use. I have acne prone skin and it does not cause breakouts. Two to three drops is all I need . Calms redny.

Having oily skin since age 12, I always stayed away from anything that said "oil" in the name. Not realizing that face oil is different. Now that I have "mature" skin I am trying to hang on to a youthful appearance, which means hydration. Even if you have oily skin you need hydration. This stuff is so nice! It has a very natural, herbal kind of scent that quickly goes away after it absorbs into your skin. You don't need a lot as you work it into your skin. I pretend I'm getting a mini 30 sec facial and really take care to gently rub this oil into my face, neck and chest. It feels really nice on. I recommend putting it on 30 min. before bed so your skin has time to absorb it vs your pillow case. If I feel my skin needs a little more hydration than just this oil I put a little bit of face moisturizer on after. In the morning my skin feels soft and smooth and I never experience dryness with this or breakouts. Just nice, happy skin.

extraits.titre: Midnight recovery oil works on my older skin
extraits.texte: This oil is wonderful on my face at night. I haven't been using it that long maybe 4 or 5 weeks but so far I really like how it works. I have older skin and wanted something to do a deep moisturizing while I slept. I was concerned since I also have a bit of oily skin yet sensitive skin to many products but so far I am pleased with my experience.

Great product! I'm 64 with mature (!) fair skin. Recently noticed my skin becoming more dry especially during the winter months. Purchased this past winter. Used it at night under moisturizer. Skin felt soft and healthier. Last a long time - just a little is needed. I have been a customer for several years. Great products!

This is one of my go-to products for cold and dry winter nights. It prevents my skin from becoming dry and flaky—just a few drops a week are enough to maintain moisture. One bottle lasts me a year and a half. However, if you have acne-prone skin, be careful not to overuse it.
